content.value_statement: Engineering tasks often stall because the next process or skill is unclear. This skill maps each situation to a focused workflow and starting point.
actual_capabilities: Routes product ideas through clarification, specification, issue creation, implementation, testing, and review.
Recommends separate workflows for incoming issues, difficult bugs, architecture maintenance, research, and learning.
Explains when to preserve, compact, or hand off conversation context.
Distinguishes multi-session projects from work that fits within one session.
Identifies prerequisite setup before using the linked engineering workflows.
limitations: It recommends other skills but does not perform their specialized work itself.
Referenced skills must be installed and available in the current environment.
Recommendations follow the documented workflow and may not match every team process.
It does not inspect project state automatically before choosing a route.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Feature
use_cases.description: Choose a path from idea clarification through implementation and review.

use_cases.title: Process Incoming Issues
use_cases.description: Route raw bug reports and feature requests into a structured triage workflow.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Difficult Bug
use_cases.description: Select a diagnosis process built around reproduction, feedback, and regression testing.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starting Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to [describe task]. Which skill should I start with, and why?
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one clear starting point.

prompt_templates.title: Route an Engineering Task
prompt_templates.prompt: My situation is [context]. Recommend the complete workflow, including decision points and session boundaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs a workflow beyond the first step.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Session Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building [feature] across several sessions. Map the skills from clarification through reviewed implementation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs durable specifications and independent issues.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Mixed Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Given [goal], [constraints], and [current artifacts], compare applicable routes and propose a staged workflow with explicit handoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user must combine research, prototyping, planning, and implementation.

output_examples.input: I have a feature idea in an existing codebase, but several design questions remain.
output_examples.output: Start with grill-with-docs. Use a prototype for questions requiring runnable evidence, then return through a handoff before creating the specification.

output_examples.input: A customer reported an intermittent regression that has no reliable test.
output_examples.output: Use diagnosing-bugs. First establish a repeatable failing command, then fix the defect and add a regression test.

output_examples.input: Our backlog contains raw bug reports and feature requests from users.
output_examples.output: Use triage for incoming issues. Convert them into agent-ready work before sending selected issues to implementation.

best_practices: Describe the task, available artifacts, and expected delivery scope.
State whether the work must span multiple sessions.
Preserve key decisions in durable documents before changing sessions.
anti_patterns: Do not triage issues already produced from an approved specification.
Do not compact context during an active planning phase.
Do not treat throwaway prototype code as production implementation.

faq.question: Does this skill implement code?
faq.answer: No. It routes work to implementation, testing, review, and other specialized skills.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can I use it without an existing codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends a stateless clarification workflow when no repository exists.

faq.question: When should I use triage?
faq.answer: Use triage for raw incoming bugs and requests, not issues already created from a specification.

faq.question: How does it handle long projects?
faq.answer: It recommends specifications, independent issues, fresh implementation sessions, and file-based handoffs.

faq.question: Does it access external websites?
faq.answer: No. The skill document contains one informational link but does not request it or transmit data.
